repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR requires a 10-minute (6000 ticks) sustain window, but the candidate uses a threshold of 601 with a 100ms period. This causes the action to fire at 60.1 seconds instead of 10 minutes. The correct threshold for a 10-minute duration on a 100ms grid is 6001 (duration/100 + 1).
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed the hold threshold from 601 to 6001 to match the 10-minute duration specified in the IR. This ensures the action only fires after the condition has been continuously true for the full 10 minutes.
